issues.legal_issue: The scope of property conveyed by a sale in execution of a money decree is determined by what the court intended to sell, assessed from the evidence, and does not extend to underlying permanent tenancy rights when only the structures were intended to be sold.
material_facts: The dispute concerned a sale in execution of a money decree and the rights conveyed by that sale.

The execution application and attached schedule described the structures standing on the land as the property to be attached and sold; a later application stated that the attached property consisted of the structures.
The landowner’s permanent tenancy rights were the subject of pending litigation when the sale took place, and a court had held that the permanent tenancy could not be terminated by eviction.
The sale purchaser was also the decree-holder, and the structures were purchased for a comparatively small sum.
issues.conclusion: The execution sale conveyed the structures, meaning their materials, but did not convey the land beneath or appurtenant to them or the permanent tenancy rights in that land. The appeal was dismissed and the decree in the landowner’s favour was upheld.
issues.legal_principle: Under Pettachi Chettiar v. Sangili Veera Pandia, in a sale in execution of a money decree the relevant questions are what the court intended to sell and what the purchaser understood was bought; these are questions of fact or mixed law and fact determined from the evidence in the particular case. Here, the execution documents, the pending dispute over the permanent tenancy, the ruling that the tenant could not be evicted, and the sale price showed that the sale was of the structures alone, not the underlying site or tenancy rights.

rule.if: execution_sale_case and execution_documents_described_structures and execution_application_identified_structures_as_attached_property and (tenancy_rights_were_in_pending_litigation or permanent_tenancy_could_not_be_terminated_by_eviction)

predicates.execution_sale_case: The dispute concerns what property was conveyed by a sale conducted to enforce a money decree.
predicates.execution_documents_described_structures: The documents used to seek or effect attachment and sale described the structures on the land as the property to be sold.
predicates.execution_application_identified_structu: The decree-holder stated in an application concerning the attached property that it consisted of the structures.
predicates.tenancy_rights_were_in_pending_litigatio: The tenant’s rights in the land were being litigated when the execution sale occurred.
predicates.permanent_tenancy_could_not_be_terminate: A court had held that the tenant’s permanent tenancy could not be terminated by eviction.
predicates.execution_sale_excludes_underlying_perma: The execution sale does not convey the permanent tenancy rights in the land beneath or appurtenant to the structures.

issues.definition: When an execution sale concerns structures described as the attached property, and the tenancy rights in the underlying land were in dispute or could not be ended by eviction, the sale excludes those permanent tenancy rights.
